source_title: Fox ESS Builds on Residential Success with Expanded C&I Solutions at All Energy Australia 2026 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
MELBOURNE, Australia , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fox ESS (Fox) showcases Power Beast , G-Max Plus, Power Cube , AirGate and FoxCloud 2.0 at Booth N123 , All Energy Australia on 28â29 October . Fox brand ambassador, Australian swimming legend Ian Thorpe joined mascot Maimai in welcoming guests.
From Residential Leadership to Rebate-Ready C&I Solutions
In August, Fox joined the Australian Prime Minister to mark 500,000 installations under the CHBP. Since May 2025, Fox has installed 4.38 GWh across Australia, enough storage for ~ 220,000 households' daily electricity needs.* " HIGHER, FASTER and SMARTER underpin our success in the residential market and our expanding portfolio in C&I," said Brooks Richard Geng, Managing Director, APAC & ME.
Power Beast and G-Max Plus address expanded SRES and NSW PDRS opportunities. Power Beast combines H3 Plus hybrid inverters and CQ7 HV batteries . It scales to 7.308 MWh on-grid or 2.923 MWh off-grid . Its pre-cabled dual-tower base reduces installation time by ~ 90% , with 1.3-metre per stack and 50 kg per module. The H3 Plus received EESS certification from DEKRA and CCS for Australian electrical safety and grid-connection compliance.
The Liquid-Cooling Cabinet All-In-One G-MAX Plus solution integrates PV , battery storage , EV charging and generator support , with on/off-grid switching in under 10 ms . It offers 50â125 kW output and 199, 221 or 241 kWh capacity options.
Power Cube integrates an inverter and EQ5500 batteries in a stackable residential solution offering 10.92â49.14 kWh with single-phase 5â12 kW and three-phase 5â15 kW. It received TÃV TS 5398 certification at the event.
Five-In-One AirGate integrates MCB, changeover, metering, bypass and CT functions, providing 63A whole-home backup , reducing wiring by at least 50% and installation costs by up to A$3,000 .**
From Higher Round-Trip Efficiency (RTE) to Smarter AI Energy Management
Fox reports 91.14% RTE , compared with 86.14% for LV systems and 81.14% for DC/DC HV systems. Assuming 20 kWh charged daily, 91.14% vs 86.14% RTE yields ~ 365 kWh more annually , ~ 6 extra full charges of a 60-kWh EV battery.
FoxCloud 2.0 combines real-time updates and flexible battery control. In Australian beta version, Maimai AI Agent turns requests into recommendations and system action. Some VPP participants even recorded daily earnings of up to A$150.
Fox will continue engaging with partners through SEC roadshows in November.
